Our Peter Rabbit Mommy and Me Pajamas are a cozy, picture-ready set spun from four layers of soft cotton gauze that breathes in summer and keeps the chill off on cooler nights. The relaxed notched collar, front patch pockets, and classic button-up placket give these pajamas a real grown-up tailoring moment — the kind you reach for on slow mornings with coffee, storybooks, and a little one curled on your lap. Gauze gets softer with every wash, so your favorite matching pair just keeps earning its keep.

The print leans storybook-sweet: a little watercolor Peter Rabbit peeks out between eucalyptus sprigs and tiny marigold blooms, scattered across an ivory ground that never feels loud. It's a look that photographs beautifully for spring and Easter memories, holiday-card mornings, grandparent visits, or simply an afternoon of meadow-walking and muffin-making at home. Pair mom's long-sleeve set with the matching children's version so every unwrapping moment, brunch, or bedtime story is effortlessly coordinated — no outfit scramble required.

Key Features:

  • Four-Layer Cotton Gauze: Breathable, airy, and buttery-soft — the more you wash it, the cozier it gets.
  • Classic Button-Up Top: Notched collar, front patch pockets, and long sleeves for real bedtime tailoring — no t-shirt shortcut.
  • Elastic-Waist Pant: Straight-leg silhouette with a stretchy pull-on waistband — easy for little ones, comfy for moms.
  • Full Size Range: Sized Child 2 Years through 9–10 Years and Mother S through XL so the whole set matches.
  • Picture-Perfect Print: Watercolor Peter Rabbit meadow art that photographs beautifully on screen and in print.

Make every morning, every photo, and every bedtime story a little softer — slip into our Peter Rabbit Mommy and Me Pajamas and make every moment match.
